# Nah, that's AI

> A free game and crowd-sourced AI-detection service: verified humans vote whether a
> photorealistic image, video, or post is AI-generated or real, and you get the crowd's
> verdict on the web, by RSS, or via API. Built by peterultimate.

## What it is

- [Play](https://nahthatsai.com/play): Guess AI vs. real one item at a time and build a streak. Free; a few rounds as a guest, then a free account.
- [Latest feed](https://nahthatsai.com/): Newest media the crowd is voting on.
- [Leaderboard](https://nahthatsai.com/leaderboard): Top human detectors by accuracy and streak.
- [Tags](https://nahthatsai.com/tags): Browse media by category.

## For developers & agents

- [Crowd-detection API](https://nahthatsai.com/api): Query the crowd's AI-vs-real verdict programmatically.
- [Agent skill](https://nahthatsai.com/skill.md): What agents can do with the site.
- [RSS feeds](https://nahthatsai.com/feeds): Latest, trending, featured, and leaderboard feeds.

## Account & pricing

- [Pricing](https://nahthatsai.com/pricing): Playing is free. Optional $2 lifetime membership and $1 API access (card via Lemon Squeezy).
- [Create account](https://nahthatsai.com/signup): Free: save streaks, appear on leaderboards, earn rewards.
